test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the third-generation fire-and-forget anti-tank guided missile that was successfully flight tested by DRDO in July 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**MPATGM.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Man Portable Anti-Tank Guided Missile (MPATGM**) is a step above Anti-Tank Guided Missiles, which can **pierce the armours of tanks.**
 
• It is a **long, low-weight missile** with four fins arranged in a circle in the middle that is equipped with a** high-explosive anti-tank (HEAT) payload.**
 
• It has a **built-in thermal sight** that enables use in **low-light situations**, including complete darkness.
 
• To determine whether the MPATGM was effective against tank targets at the lower end of its range spectrum, which is between** 200 and 300 meters**, tests were conducted.
 
• MPATGM will be manufactured by** Bharat Dynamics Limited **at a facility located in** Bhanoor, Telangana.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **SAMHO:**

 
 
• The **Armament Research and Development Establishment (ARDE)** created the SAMHO, an** Indian gun-launched anti-tank guided missile**, for the Arjun tanks of the Indian Army.

 It is a versatile **anti-armour guided missile** that can be used against both tanks and low-flying assault helicopters.
 
 
 
• **HELINA:**
 
 
• HELINA is one of the** most advanced anti-tank weapons** in the world. The missile has a maximum range of** 7 kilometres.**
 
 
 
• **SANT:**
 
 
• **Stand off anti-tank missile** is a surface-to-air missile.
 
• The weapon can reach targets at a distance of up to** ten kilometers. **The** DRDO** developed the missile.
